title: Operator Space Transport and the Emergence of Boundary Time Crystals
summary: Boundary time crystals (BTCs) are prominent examples of continuous time crystals in collective spin systems governed by Lindbladian evolution. To date, their analysis has mostly relied on semiclassical and numerical approaches. Here, we develop a fully quantum-compatible framework to classify collective spin dynamics and show that BTC behavior emerges from the absence of non-trivial weak symmetries of the Liouvillian.
